title: Each Send on the waiting page wakes the writer, which exports the git copy then
ruling: Owner 14:24 CST, page item 757 a: yes, each Send wakes the writer, which exports the git copy then. This replaces the "timely, not real time" half of item 593 a for a Send: the copy is refreshed at each Send, still a snapshot of that moment (a later save is not in it). Option b (keep the timely export and the stated age) is not chosen.
